audio.Scope: Real isolated AAC-LC/24-bit Ogg FLAC, synthetic live mix and recovery only. Includes five-signal fixed source gain and two low-crest normalized AAC-LC/FLAC branches. Includes synthetic final-mix limiter and prepared/audible recovery ownership. No HE-AAC/18-output/worst-case encoded limiter/headroom/actual-PC/24-72h or mouse acceptance.

encodedListeners.Scope: Low-crest synthetic programme; not worst-case codec-headroom qualification

Details.scope: Synthetic full-file source measurement, fixed-gain PCM, finite playout and history only. Two loopback AAC-LC/FLAC branches use a low-crest synthetic programme only; no final-mix limiter, worst-case codec headroom, HE-AAC, all-18-output, production media or commissioning acceptance.

Cases.Source: New independent implementation; no production configuration or services accessed.

Checks.Description: Preroll may prepare an entire short programme without committing its start or EOF.
The finite processed programme preserves all 2,160 real frames without delay padding.
No completed event precedes its actual output frame boundary.
Prepared short music/ad/sweeper boundaries retain their exact output sample positions.
Processed finite events preserve the immutable journal chain.
Three in-flight queued sources are selected once even before any prior completion can commit.
Queue consumption follows published terminal boundaries and their durable transactions.
Stop after the first output block never announces the already prepared next source.
Stop preserves the audible unfinished source, not a future prepared terminal/checkpoint.
Restart adds the entire unfinished source and successor to the committed output clock.
Recovery links a new attempt and restarts the unfinished source from its original first sample.
A prepared but unheard successor is consumed only when actually published after restart.
Skip observed in an already buffered EOF window never skips the unheard next item.
A late accepted Skip is consumed by the finished occurrence instead of surviving into another item.
Buffered Skip preserves immutable exact-boundary history.
Programme audio keeps advancing through a 350 ms journal-writer stall, including the checkpoint interval; pending durable writes remain visible.
The bounded audit backlog drains durably after storage returns.
Synthetic mic/music mix retains exact finite programme length.
The final mixed signal is genuinely oversampled and limited after microphone ducking/mixing.
Processing qualification closes every owned decoder/validation worker.

Events.Title: a
Events.Detail: Explicit stop discards only unread preparation; restart begins a new attempt at the item's beginning.
